title: Form missing GREG functions (network flows, shortest paths, linear programs) from installed open-source packages, accepted only on GREG's certificate
problem: The founder corrected on #143 (draft #144): open-source mechanisms are an active construction supply chain, P5/P7 must search and qualify existing libraries before hand-building, and VEPMC is not a development stopping condition. GREG's genesis could acquire executables only; a mission needing a shortest route, a maximum flow or a continuous linear optimum had no certified provider.
baseline: Genesis searches attached, verified, installed executables, a builder, then the founder. #140's cognition.graph op answers one s-t path via NetworkX, checked for validity but not optimality.

alternatives.name: DEPEND on installed packages behind GREG's certificate (chosen)
alternatives.description: Genesis pins an installed distribution on a Mechanism Card, qualifies it in a no-network interpreter against GREG's oracle, registers it VERIFIED; the founder attaches; every answer must pass an O(edges) certificate GREG owns
advantages: engines become interchangeable because the certificate, not the engine, is trusted
disadvantages: the license is read from metadata, not reviewed
on the probe a 20-line local implementation was as fast

alternatives.name: Write the algorithms locally
alternatives.description: Ship GREG's own Dijkstra and Edmonds-Karp as built-ins
disadvantages: rebuilds solved technology against the founder's correction
alternatives.revival_evidence: the packages become unavailable on Body 1, or per-call start-up dominates a real mission

alternatives.name: Vendor the NetworkX modules
alternatives.description: Copy the shortest-path and flow modules into the tree
disadvantages: update burden and notice obligations for code already installed
alternatives.revival_evidence: a body that may not carry the dependency

alternatives.name: Extend #140's cognition.graph op
alternatives.description: Add flow and certificates to the in-process op family
disadvantages: imports the engine into the body process; no acquisition, pinning or replacement
alternatives.revival_evidence: a decision to retire genesis for cognition functions

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Graph questions stay unanswered or uncertified; the founder's correction is recorded but not executed

roles.position: Single agent performing all five roles (a stated limitation). The correction asks for reuse as construction, not as comparison, and for continued building. The chosen route depends on installed engines, invents only the certificate and the qualification, and keeps attach with the founder.
material_concerns: the founder may prefer automatic attach for read-only functions

roles.position: The supply chain lives inside the existing genesis loop: same deficit, registry, attach, quarantine and repair. The new parts are a package candidate, a Mechanism Card and a per-function certificate. No second registry or plane.
material_concerns: catalog entries are hand-written per function

roles.position: A lying engine is caught by the certificate, quarantined and replaced by a different package; an engine imported from another location or version is refused; changed pinned files quarantine at restart. The oracle caught two real integration defects.
material_concerns: unpinned files of a distribution can change undetected

roles.position: Nothing is installed by GREG. If no engine is installed the ask names it. Pins break on upgrade by design and require requalification.
material_concerns: upgrades quarantine the capability until requalified

roles.position: Answers are read-only; the receipt carries engine, license and authority_created false; the founder sees license and qualification before attaching.
material_concerns: license read from metadata is not legal review

evidence.claim: Every installed engine qualifies for its functions
evidence.finding: 6 of 6 engine/function pairs qualified (NetworkX and SciPy for shortest path and maximum flow; SciPy HiGHS and OR-Tools GLOP for linear programs) on frozen cases plus a certified scale probe

evidence.claim: A plan closes on a duality certificate
evidence.finding: words -> deficit -> qualified LP engine -> certified optimum with shadow prices; an impossible plan never closes

evidence.claim: A mission closes on a capability absent at its start
evidence.finding: deficit -> card -> founder attach -> certified 7-mile route; VERIFIED appraisal

evidence.claim: A lying engine is replaced, never believed
evidence.finding: NetworkX quarantined on the certificate; SciPy re-formed; every accepted distance correct

counterevidence.finding: on the graph probes a plain-Python Dijkstra and Edmonds-Karp matched or beat the packages' solve time, before the ~0.25 s interpreter start; for linear programs no simple local alternative exists

counterevidence.claim: Infeasible and unbounded claims stay unproved
counterevidence.finding: neither LP interface returns a Farkas certificate, so GREG reports the engine's claim and never closes on it
NetworkX names the source its own predecessor across a zero-weight self-loop; a sparse matrix sums parallel edges. The frozen oracle caught the first; the second is pinned by a mutant test

pass_1.intended_outcome: GREG answers network questions with engines it did not write, and trusts only its own proof

advantages.amplified_value: any installed package with a runner and a certificate can serve; the founder's supply chain becomes executable
engines are interchangeable; the moat is the proof, not the solver
a lying engine is replaced by a different package through the existing self-repair loop

disadvantages.redesigned_response: batch the qualification; isolate per call (metric: probe wall time recorded)
card states the limit; founder decides attach seeing it
RECORD plus mechanism files plus shared dependency RECORD digests; restart quarantines

comparisons.baseline: executables-only genesis; #140 cognition.graph without optimality certificate
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: vendoring NetworkX modules into the tree
comparisons.reversible_experiment: two catalog functions behind genesis; founder attach; detachable

rejected_alternatives.name: Vendor NetworkX modules
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: update and notice burden for installed code
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: a body that may not carry the dependency

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked engine lies, location and version substitution, file tampering, repair re-admission, console attach forgery, false infeasibility and input outside competence. Fourteen mutants remove one safeguard each; 55 of 55 are caught.

new_weaknesses.statement: A repair search could re-admit the package that just lied
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: repair skips the quarantined identity; re-admission needs the founder

new_weaknesses.statement: A shadowing module on the path could stand in for the engine
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: isolated -I interpreter; imported file must lie under the qualified location; version must match

new_weaknesses.statement: Common-mode failure between SciPy and NumPy
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: shared dependency disclosed on the card and pinned; the certificate shares no code

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: isolation is worth 0.25 s per call
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a mission latency budget below one second

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: founder decides attach seeing the license
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a copyleft or undeclared license on a candidate
a tamper not caught at restart

pass_2.final_design: Package candidates in genesis; Mechanism Card; batch qualification on GREG's oracle and a scale probe; founder attach (console or CLI) unless the signed mission pre-authorizes read-only attach; per-call pin and certificate; quarantine and fault-diverse repair

residual_risks.mitigation: the ask names them; GREG installs nothing

entries.position: For two functions this small, local code would do
entries.rationale: measured: local matched or beat the packages
entries.evidence_threshold: a third function where no local implementation is simple

migration_plan: Additive on the draft branch: two genesis catalog functions, one template, a console attach button for verified candidates using the existing CAPABILITY_ATTACH command. Existing genesis functions and their tests are unchanged.
kill_criteria: an uncertified engine answer is ever accepted
GREG installs or downloads a package
a quarantined package is re-admitted without the founder
review_trigger: the third package-backed function, or Body 1 lacking the engines
